title: CEFR Level Assessment across Languages and Text Granularities
abstract: arXiv:2610.41553v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic assessment of textual CEFR levels is an important task in educational natural language processing. However, accurate CEFR level prediction remains challenging due to the naturally imbalanced distribution of CEFR levels and the ambiguous boundaries between adjacent levels. To address these challenges, we propose a unified training objective that combines focal loss with supervised contrastive learning. Focal loss mitigates class imbalance by emphasizing underrepresented and difficult examples, while supervised contrastive learning learns more discriminative representations by encouraging intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. We evaluate the proposed method on sentence- and document-level CEFR assessment in both monolingual and multilingual settings. translated_title: 跨语言与跨文本粒度的CEFR等级评估
translated_abstract: 自动评估文本的CEFR等级是教育自然语言处理中的一项重要任务。然而，由于CEFR等级分布天然不均衡，且相邻等级之间边界模糊，准确的CEFR等级预测仍然具有挑战性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种统一的训练目标，将焦点损失与监督对比学习相结合。焦点损失通过强调欠代表样本和困难样本来缓解类别不平衡问题，而监督对比学习通过促进类内紧凑性和类间分离性来学习更具判别性的表示。我们在单语和多语环境下，对句子级和文档级CEFR评估进行了方法评估。实验结果表明，我们的方法在所有设置中始终优于强大的基线方法，在多项基准上建立了新的最先进性能。
tldr: 该论文提出将焦点损失与监督对比学习相结合的统一训练目标，有效解决了CEFR等级分布不均衡和相邻等级边界模糊的问题，在单语和多语环境下的句子级与文档级评估中均取得了新的最先进性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified training objective combining focal loss with supervised contrastive learning to address class imbalance and ambiguous boundaries between adjacent CEFR levels, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across monolingual and multilingual settings at both sentence and document levels.
